propositions: The tickets-store has 561 pre-existing fsck diagnostics (550 stale-channel, 10 orphan-event, 1 status-fork-resolved) that must be safely repaired without mutating the intentional audit record.
All 10 orphan events are LINK-type and auto-recoverable; they span 9 tickets with 8 additional tickets having mixed stale-channel and orphan faults that must be refused during stale-only repair.

The scoped stale-channel repair feature (Gerrit 1391) requires dry-run validation, resumable batch processing with --limit, commit-and-push atomicity, mixed-fault refusal, and rollback capability before live execution.

Live quiet-window repair must be executed in order (orphan repair first, then stale-channel batches) with writer pause confirmation, disposable backup verification, and post-repair fsck validation to zero repairable findings.
